\]

\[
I_t = I_{t-1} + p_t - s_t
\]

I_t \leq 500, \quad t = 1, 2, 3
\]

\[
p_t, s_t, I_t \geq 0 \text{ and integer}, \quad t = 1, 2, 3
\]

- No purchase limit.
- Can buy and sell in the same month.
